hypothesis: At equal stored recurrent-state capacity, normalized linear minLSTM improves long-delay passive retention over linear minGRU enough to justify its extra gate projection.
primary_metric: Final four-query accuracy on passive retention with 256 intervening tokens; absolute paired percentage-point difference.
minimum_useful_effect: +5 percentage points mean across three seeds
success_rule: Mean paired gain >=5pp, positive gain on all three seeds, and both minimal cells achieve >=90% mean accuracy at delay64. Otherwise no retention promotion.
futility_rule: Complete every registered trial unless nonfinite values, fidelity failure, or time limit. Preserve failures; no reseeding.

authorization.reference: User 2026-10-17 explicitly requests an LSTM-like minGRU variant test over retention and relative performance/compute against minGRU and normal LSTM.
authorization.resources: Existing local CPU only; no external compute, costs, or language-model training.

mingru64.note: State excludes weights, optimizer, activations and allocator. MACs exclude gates, scan and readout.

minlstm64.note: State excludes weights, optimizer, activations and allocator. MACs exclude gates, scan and readout.

lstm32.note: State excludes weights, optimizer, activations and allocator. MACs exclude gates, scan and readout.

lstm64.note: State excludes weights, optimizer, activations and allocator. MACs exclude gates, scan and readout.

design.source: Feng et al., arXiv:2410.01201v3, section3; normalized signed linear minLSTM and signed linear minGRU. Normal LSTM torch.nn.LSTM. No curve rotation or hierarchy.
design.control_rationale: minGRU64/minLSTM64/LSTM32 each store64 floats. LSTM64 controls hidden width but stores128 floats. Parameters and compute are measured, not matched.
design.seed_selection_method: Consecutive fixed seed IDs reserved before all runs; distinct from parent study.
design.initialization: All gate weights zero at initialization; carry=.95 and write=.05 exactly for all cells; normal LSTM output gate=.5. Candidate and readout use default PyTorch random initialization.
design.readout: Four linear eight-class heads; visible query token selects the key. Same mechanism for all arms; no lock/answer simulator state passed. Changed from parent study, so raw accuracies are not directly comparable.

pilot.purpose: Fixed budget numerical and throughput check only. No selection or hyperparameter tuning. Selection evaluations at32/64 use separate seeds881101/881102.

data.task_source: Exact tasks.py copy from parent curve experiment. Four keys, eight values, two keys locked, optional conflict/reopening, simulator labels only.
data.training_seed: 700000000+model_seed*10000+step; per-step mode/length RNG=model_seed+123456. Same across every arm.
data.confirmation_batches: 4 batches of32 per seed, seed+100*k, 256 episodes per cell/mode/delay.
data.research_wide_reuse: Same synthetic grammar as parent study. Fresh model/train/eval seeds; prior grammar findings informed this design. No benchmark claims.

training.optimizer: AdamW lr.003 cosine to.0003, beta(.9,.95), eps1e-8, decay.01 all parameters; global gradient clip1
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Exact query count and SHA256 recorded per seed; identical across all four arms. Variable episode lengths.
training.bptt: Full episode; scan and native LSTM gradients verified; state reset each episode, no TBPTT.
training.checkpoint_selection: Final step only; checkpoint hash frozen before confirmation.
training.objective: Mean eight-class cross entropy on all visible query tokens; intermediate and final queries.

execution.implementation: Hillis-Steele affine scan O(T log T) work for minimal cells; optimized native nn.LSTM. No compiler/custom kernels.
execution.fidelity: FP64 outputs/input+parameter gradients/carry/one AdamW update <2e-12; FP32 outputs/gradients/carry/post-update outputs <2e-6. FP32 parameter differences <5e-5; Adam near-zero-gradient amplification documented in VERIFICATION_ATTEMPT_1.json.

evaluation.uncertainty: Show all model seeds and seed range; three training seeds are descriptive, not a high-powered population test.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Reload every checkpoint and exactly replay primary endpoint; duplicates are reproducibility checks, not extra independent evidence.
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: One preregistered primary minLSTM-minus-minGRU contrast; normal LSTM controls and other modes/lengths are descriptive.

deployment.timing: After training, one isolated process,1 CPU thread; model+readout+embedding. Batch32 length64/256/1024 full training with optimizer20 reps after5 warmups; prefill30 after5; decodebatch1/32 200 after20.
deployment.units: Median CPU and wall milliseconds; report10th/90th percentiles. Measured implementation/hardware specific; not GPU results.
deployment.memory: Analytic persistent recurrent FP32 state separately from parameters and observed process peakRSS. PeakRSS includes Python/Torch, not activation-only memory.

preservation: Code, compact traces, raw scores and receipts to authorized JRowe47/Super-1 research branch. Checkpoints/full traces in durable companion archive. No upstream PR or merge.
